# Random Memes

> random-memes is a random meme API for Node.js: a zero-dependency package and CLI that returns a random meme image from Lemmy meme communities, with TypeScript types.

Install with `npm install random-memes` (Node.js 20 or newer). Call `await random()` to get `{ image, category, caption, permalink }`; it works with `require` and with named ES module imports. `reddit()` is deprecated, fails with HTTP 403 in most environments and will be removed in v5.

## Docs

- [Usage](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/usage.html): installation, CommonJS, ES module and TypeScript usage, the CLI, error handling and upgrading from v3
- [random()](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/random.html): which Lemmy communities are used, caching, the return shape and when the call rejects
- [Meme API: Get Random Memes as JSON](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/meme-api.html): a real response, serving memes as JSON from your own HTTP server, the CLI and where the memes come from
- [reddit() (deprecated)](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/reddit.html): the deprecated subreddit method and its parameters
- [Random meme](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/random-meme/): a live page that shows random image memes from Lemmy in the browser, NSFW filtered

## Blog

- [How to get a Reddit API key](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/reddit-api-key.html): approval, OAuth, User-Agent and rate limits
- [Is the Reddit API free?](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/is-reddit-api-free.html): free access, commercial use and 403 without auth
- [Build a Discord meme bot](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/discord-meme-bot.html): a /meme slash command with discord.js
- [Lemmy vs Reddit for developers](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/lemmy-vs-reddit.html): access, limits, federation and data rules
- [Lemmy API in JavaScript](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/lemmy-api.html): /api/v3/post/list, fields and paging
- [Meme generator API vs random meme API](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/meme-generator-api.html): Imgflip, memegen.link and random-memes
- [Filter NSFW posts from Lemmy](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/lemmy-nsfw-filter.html): the flags random-memes checks
- [Random memes in the terminal](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/random-memes-cli.html): the CLI, JSON output and shell greetings
- [Reddit alternatives](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/reddit-alternatives.html): Lemmy, PieFed, Mbin and Tildes compared, and which have an open API
- [Promise.all vs Promise.allSettled](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/promise-allsettled.html): Promise.all vs Promise.allSettled with real requests
- [CommonJS vs ESM](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/commonjs-vs-esm.html): named exports, cjs-module-lexer and require(esm)
- [Mock fetch with node:test](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/node-test-runner-mock-fetch.html): mocking fetch and Date with node:test
- [JavaScript fetch timeout](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/javascript-fetch-timeout.html): AbortSignal.timeout, error names and Node defaults
- [User-Agent in fetch](https://projects.halit.org/random-memes/blog/fetch-user-agent.html): forbidden or not, Chrome vs Node, what to send
